column1: # The heap region is the reserve minus the 0x10000000 base offset, the alias region and the stack (hle_svc.c mem_init), so a 5 GB reserve left only
# 0x8000000 of heap and the game aborted in nninitStartup ("SetHeapSize OOM: req 0xc9400000 > cap 0x8000000").
# The game asks for the heap itself at main+0x1b66160: 0xC9400000 = its application pool 0xCD500000 - 64 MB of used memory - 1 MB, so with the 16 MB
# system resource in |sys_resource| the heap must hold the whole pool. 8 GB of reserve with a 4 GB alias region gives it 0xE0000000 (3.5 GB).
# The upstream heap check (the Mac host) is what derives this split automatically; this one was written by hand from the request above and is what runs.
